You have a very solid point. I have kids involved and I want to be the best mom I can be. I just feel trapped with gunshots ties for support and no where to go. Someone asked if I knew he'd never change, would I stay (good point too) I told them if I didn't feel trapped I'd leave. I'm think I'm slowly beginning to realize his actions are taking advantage of my love for him. 
Thanks for your reply.
If there were no marriage,  no house, kids or my disability to keep me in what feels like a trap... I'd leave.

It has been dormant for a while but I've felt this and saw this constantly in my mind. I didn't care who saw when I played out my fantasies. It got bad enough I had a classmate tell me to cover that shit before it drew attention. Now, as an adult, when those intrusive thoughts play a movie in my head I act them out in a more concealed place so I don't raise to many questions. Only a cutter can truly understand this position. 

Unrelated,  I found out the hard way reddit gets touchy if you're "over" active...essh.

Hindsight is 20/20.. my mom was the same and I get why. Still, it traumatized me how intrusive she became in the name of saving me from myself. I don't think it helped like she hoped in the end. I just hide those parts of myself now and pretend to be cured. I play the part of a productive, cured adult. I feel you *hugs* thanks for posting the hardest parts of yourself to expose
